data.item: THE KENYA POWER AND LIGHTING COMPANY PLC UNAUDITED TRADING RESULTS FOR SIX MONTHS PERIOD ENDED31 DECEMBER 2023 The Board of Directors of the Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc announce Key Highlights for the Half -Year Ended 31 December 2023 the unaudited accounts for the half-year period ended 31 December 2023: In the half year trading period ended 31 December 2023, Kenya Power & Lighting Company Plc recorded a profit before tax of KSh.538 Million compared to a CONDENSED STATEMENT OF COMPREHENSIVE INCOME FOR loss before tax of KSh.1,589 Million realized in the similar period in December THE PERIOD ENDED 31 DECEMBER 2023 2022, an increase of KSh.2,127 Million. The improved profitability is attributed to increased revenue resulting from increased electricity sales. 31.12.2023 31.12.2022 Revenue from electricity sales increased by 31% from KSh.86,666 Million to Ksh Million Ksh Million KSh.113,552 Million. Additionally, the adoption of a more cost-reflective tariff review in April 2023 as well as the growth in unit sales by 129 GWh. Revenue from contracts with customers 113,552 86,666 Cost of sales (83,028) (69,793) Non-fuel power purchase costs increased by KSh.9,788 Million in comparison to the preceding similar period. This increase is attributed to the depreciation of the Kenyan shilling against major global currencies, in which the Power Gross Margin 30,524 16,873 Purchase Agreements (PPAs) are denominated. Over the six-months, there was an increase in units purchased from renewable sources by 240 GWh, while Other income 3,655 6,788 units purchased from thermal generation sources reduced by 93 GWh from Operating costs (19,726) (18,009) 650 GWh in a similar period in 2022 to 557 GWh leading to a decrease in fuel cost recoveries by KSh. 2,048 Million. This increase is attributed to the rise in unrealized foreign exchange losses on loan revaluations, a consequence of the weakening of the Kenya Shilling against major foreign CONDENSED STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL POSITION AS AT 31 currencies in which most of the loan portfolio is denominated.
